description: The documented contract of the Open API Wi-Fi network (SSID) binding write, "Update SSID binding ap groups" (docs/omada-openapi-ops.md, controller 6.3.0.45 spec), used by the OpenApiClient contract tests (src/main/openapi-client.ts updateSsidApGroups()): method, versioned path ({omadacId}, {siteId}, {ssidId} placeholders), the exact request body (only the required apGroupIds: the complete new set of bound AP groups), the documented success answer (no result) and the documented operation-specific errorCode. Every id is made up.
